# Sveltia CMS Authenticator

Source: https://github.com/sveltia/sveltia-cms-auth

Pinned commit: f3beae35865b49c91f8d98d89f0eed5fbb49167f

`index.js` is an unmodified copy of upstream `src/index.js`. The MIT license is included alongside it. The small Vercel adapter lives in `lib/cms-auth.js`.

Review upstream changes before replacing this copy. Run `npm test` after any update. The site intentionally restricts OAuth to public repositories and a fixed list of its own domains.
